prompt:
You are a equity research analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-02-05, give a 20-trading-day directional recommendation for the stock.
Valid answers (choose exactly one): BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Company information (as of 2026-02-05):
| Return 3m            | -45.0% |
| Return 1m            | -29.6% |
| Return 1w            | -19.2% |
| Range position (63d) | 0% |
| 21d realized vol     | 55% |
| Last close           | 136.48 |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock has a strong downtrend with large negative returns (3m: -45%, 1m: -29.6%, 1w: -19.2%) and elevated volatility (21d realized vol ~55%). Without a visible recovery catalyst, the near-term path is likely to stay weak, suggesting renewed downside risk over the next ~20 trading days. Therefore, a SELL stance is appropriate.

DECISION: SELL
